prompt: Why is the note about Station 2 relevant to the committee’s decision?
promptZh: 第二站的備註為何和委員會的決定有關？

options.text: It shows that neither station needs a label holder.
options.zh: 它顯示兩站都不需要標籤架。
options.whyZh: 第二站未調整標籤就能讀到，但兩站都使用標籤架，沒有做無架試驗。

options.text: It gives a reason not to prescribe the same height adjustment at both stations.
options.zh: 它說明為什麼不應規定兩站都以相同方式調高標籤。
options.whyZh: 第二站原本已看得清楚；把標籤上移是為了讓第一站的指示露出，而且委員會需要分站提出建議。

options.text: It proves that raising the label would make Station 2 fail.
options.zh: 它證明第二站把標籤上移後會測試失敗。
options.whyZh: 試驗沒有描述第二站調高標籤後表現變差，不能推定上移必定有害。

options.text: It establishes that the holder with the lower rail at Station 1 must be replaced.
options.zh: 它證明第一站有下擋條的標籤架必須換掉。
options.whyZh: 第一站使用原架把標籤上移後已讀得清楚，沒有證明非換架不可。

explanationZh: 第二站原本已看得清楚；把標籤上移是為了讓第一站的指示露出，而且委員會需要分站提出建議。
evidence: At Station 2 the instruction was already visible before anyone moved the label. / The committee needs a separate recommendation for each station; it is not deciding whether the label should replace the old one everywhere.

evidenceSpans.exactQuote: At Station 2 the instruction was already visible before anyone moved the label.
The committee needs a separate recommendation for each station; it is not deciding whether the label should replace the old one everywhere.

vocabulary.note: 在作業建議裡指建議或規定具體做法，不只指醫師開處方。
